svg.title: Salsifis — Tragopogon porrifolius
svg.desc: Edible white salsify, lifted with its slender ivory taproot and sparse fine rootlets. Long grasslike grey-green leaves surround a curved flowering stem. The violet composite head consists of many fine toothed ligulate florets, with eight long pointed green bracts extending beyond the petals. One detached, finely feathered pappus seed floats beside the specimen.
